title: FindingSchema v1
description: JMCRA Finding JSON Schema — canonical contract for all downstream consumers (JIRA, Slack, SonarQube import). Spec: Section 4.2 (Stage 4 — Rule Evaluators). SPC-031.

ruleId.description: Stable rule identifier in DOM-NNN format (e.g., 'SEC-001'). Never changes once published.

title.description: Short, human-readable title for the finding.

file.description: Relative source file path where the violation was detected (from repo root).

line.description: 1-based line number of the violation. Must be within the actual file.

snippet.description: Short code snippet illustrating the violation (max 200 chars). Empty string if not applicable.

message.description: Detailed, technical explanation of why this is a problem.

remediation.description: Actionable remediation guidance for the developer.

references.description: External reference identifiers (CWE, OWASP, docs links).

confidence.description: Model confidence in the finding. LLM-only findings have confidence < 0.5 (Section 6.3).

ruleVersion.description: The version of the rule that produced this finding (semver string).
